description: This file is a shell script that appears to be a test suite for the 'git rerere' feature, including setup, tests for conflict resolution, garbage collection, and edge cases.

methods.name: concat_insert
methods.description: Concatenates 'early' content, followed by specified arguments, and then 'late' content, ending with a last parameter.

methods.name: count_pre_post
methods.description: Counts preimage and postimage files in the .git/rr-cache directory, ensuring their counts match expected numbers.

methods.name: merge_conflict_resolve
methods.description: Resets the repository and simulates a merge conflict resolution by creating specific combined file contents.

methods.name: rerere_gc_custom_expiry_test
methods.description: Performs a test of rerere garbage collection with custom expiry times, verifying cache consistency after forced expiration.
